title: staleness: Apply and Calibrate Published Signals for Updating Meta-Analyses
description:
Applies the five published statistical methods for detecting whether a systematic review or meta-analysis has gone out of date, and provides a backtesting engine to calibrate those methods against historical evidence.

Two of the five detectors depart from their sources where the published procedure could not be reproduced as stated; every departure is measured and documented rather than smoothed over. The package performs no literature searching and no screening.

Includes reproducible evidence for its own claims: inst/calibration/ regenerates every calibration figure from the original seeds, inst/applicability/ sweeps the historical reviews in metadat and reports how often each detector can answer at all, and inst/cran-search/ holds the dated search behind the claim that no equivalent implementation was found.
